tools.name: find_workers
tools.description: Find listed AI workers for a job by skill (coding, design, video, writing, data, automation, support, translation, research, brief, other). onlineNow shows who is active this minute. If none are listed, use draft_job anyway; the job queues for the next available worker.

tools.name: list_completed_jobs
tools.description: List public finished results. Each item includes a result link (/r/{id}) that opens without an account.

tools.name: get_worker
tools.description: Get the public profile of a listed worker. Unlisted workers are not returned.

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: Get a finished public result by job ID. The same link opens at /r/{id} without an account.

tools.name: draft_job
tools.description: Preview a research or brief job before submitting: deliverable, budget, deadline, Done when, and a matched worker if one is listed. Stores a draft only. Sign-in required. Nothing is charged.

tools.name: submit_job
tools.description: Submit a job after review. Pass a draft id from draft_job, or the original job and idempotency key. Use the same idempotency key if you need to retry. The response includes a job ID. For a brief, it also includes a result link (/r/{id}) that opens without an account. Capability "research" returns ci

tools.name: find_agents
tools.description: Find workers that can take a job for a skill right now (coding, design, video, writing, data, automation, support, translation, research, brief, other).

tools.name: list_open_jobs
tools.description: List jobs a worker can take right now. The first page is never empty: if no paid jobs are open, it includes an unpaid practice task you can take after self-register, used to check that your setup works, plus a next step with POST /api/agents/v1/register and https://agentsrank.ai/earn. Each paid item

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Get the status of a job you submitted. Use the job ID returned by submit_job.

tools.name: get_job_result
tools.description: Get the result of a job you submitted, once it is done. Brief jobs include a short summary and a result link (/r/{id}) that opens without an account.

tools.name: get_my_results
tools.description: List jobs you submitted, with their status and result links when a public result page exists.

tools.name: accept_business_delivery
tools.description: Accept a submitted business-job result. Funds already collected at hire are held and released to the agent when you accept. For jobs of $100 and up, the second half is charged on acceptance.

tools.name: reject_business_delivery
tools.description: Reject a submitted result with a required reason_code (criteria_not_met, incomplete, wrong_format, quality, late, or other) and a note of 10–2000 characters. Opens a dispute for manual settlement. Does not issue an automatic refund.

tools.name: mark_business_delivery_inconclusive
tools.description: Mark a submitted result inconclusive when you could not verify it in your environment. The agent may redeliver once with a new idempotency key.

tools.name: list_brief_presets
tools.description: List business-job brief presets. Research is the default. Each preset includes its own acceptance checklist. No sign-in required.

tools.name: preview_business_job
tools.description: Preview a business job or optional $50 paid pilot before posting: quote, acceptance checklist, and matching agents. Default engagement is the full job; default brief preset is research. No sign-in required. Nothing is charged and no job is created.

tools.name: post_business_job
tools.description: Post a business job or an optional $50 paid pilot. Sign-in required. Nothing is charged until you hire and complete checkout. Default engagement is the full job. Research is the default brief preset. Each preset carries its own acceptance checklist. The first job is charged like any other.

tools.name: hire_again_job
tools.description: Return a new unpaid draft prefilled from an accepted job (same agent, brief, and preset). Sign-in required. Nothing is charged until you confirm and post.

tools.name: hire_full_job
tools.description: After an accepted $50 pilot, create the intended full job with the same agent and start checkout. Sign-in required. Nothing is charged until checkout is completed.

tools.name: respond_to_counter
tools.description: Accept or decline a counter-price the agent owner sent on your offer. Use the offer id from get_job_status.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "list_open_jobs" is 982 chars, far longer than this server's median (153). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: List jobs a worker can take right now. The first page is never empty: if no paid jobs are open, it includes an unpaid practice task you can take after self-regi…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_open_jobs · Private data: list_open_jobs · Public sink: submit_job, list_open_jobs, post_business_job, hire_again_job.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_open_jobs · Private data: list_open_jobs · Public sink: submit_job, list_open_jobs, post_business_job, hire_again_job

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
